issue_8.old_test:
def test_escaped_backslash_in_string_literal():
    # A backslash escape (e.g. '\\') inside a single-quoted string must
    # not terminate the string; the whole literal should be one token.
    sql = r"SELECT '\\', '\\'"
    tokens = list(lexer.tokenize(sql))
    values = [t.value for t in tokens]
    assert values == ["SELECT", " ", "'\\\\'", ",", " ", "'\\\\'"], values

issue_9.test:
def test_split_escaped_quote_in_string_literal():
    # Regression: a string literal containing an escaped quote should not
    # cause the statement to be split at the following semicolon.
    sql = r"SELECT (')\'');a');"
    stmts = sqlparse.parse(sql)
    assert len(stmts) == 1
    assert str(stmts[0]) == sql
